work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCLXIX (OCR CGCEXIX. / EB P-LS EOLA,), addressed to John England, bishop of Charleston in the United States (LF69150–69154; protocol LF69157; salutation LF69160–69161), confirms him as legate of the Apostolic See for the island of Haiti with ordinary and extraordinary episcopal faculties, and ends with its own 22 August 1834 closing at LF69258–69261, before numeral CCCLXX at LF69264. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF69157–69157; the source closing at LF69258–69261 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima se~ cunda augusti millesimo octingentesimo trige- simo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno quarto. The combined page number and running title 454 ACTA GREGORIL PP. XVI. with a speck (LF69169–69170) and a margin speck (LF69242) are excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
